tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Synergistic effects of P-113, Phe-P-113, Bip-P-113, Dip-P-113, and Nal-P-113 in combination with vancomycin against bacterial strains studied. All of the experiments were performed in triplicate.
footnotes: a VAN, vancomycin (μg/mL). b FICI, fractional inhibitory concentration index, FICI ≤ 0.5, synergy; 0.5 < FICI ≤ 4, no interaction; FICI > 4, antagonism [13].
